name: slatwall-ts
description: Extracted Slatwall Catalog slice - Product, Sku, Brand, Option and the Google product-feed adapter - as a strict-mode TypeScript AWS Lambda service over the existing MySQL Sw* schema.
//: The overrides block below is a SECURITY REMEDIATION, not a preference: it closes
GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg / CVE-2026-14257 (unbounded brace expansion) by replacing the two
CONSUMERS of brace-expansion inside the Jest toolchain. NEVER add brace-expansion itself:
5.x is ESM with named exports while minimatch 1/2/3 require the default-export expand
function, so that override fails at runtime with "expand is not a function".
minimatch is pinned rather than glob because glob 13 is only reachable by replacing the
glob that jest's own reporters require, whereas pinning minimatch fixes the leaf consumer
both vulnerable paths share and leaves jest's resolved graph intact. Verified: npm ci
exit 0, npm audit 0 vulnerabilities, npm install --package-lock-only produces no lockfile
change, and the full suite green. This note IS the rationale - it is deliberately kept here,
beside the block it explains, rather than in jest.config.ts, because a reader auditing the
overrides reads this file and package.json admits no comment syntax other than a '//' member.
